features.name: Provider Quota Probe
features.description: Worker probes each supported Provider connection on a schedule and stores upstream balance or usage-window utilization in provider_quota_summary, one row per (provider, connection), with entries normalized to a shared shape; unsupported Providers store an explicit error_code instead of an empty result, and probing is switchable per connection.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/provider-quota.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/provider-quota.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-20: TDD red-to-green for steps 1.6-1.10. packages/db/src/provider-jobs.ts gained a quota-specific connection enumeration (listDueProviderQuotaProbeConnections, predicate carries quota_probe_enabled = true) plus enqueueProviderQuotaProbeJob (advisory lock, pending/running dedupe, max_attempts 3, notifyJobCreated); packages/worker-runtime/src/worker-provider-quota-probe.ts is the handler (unsupported quotaSource and local providers write entries=[] with their reason and never call upstream; quota_probe_enabled=false returns canceled and writes no row; OAuth expiry refresh with ciphertext-guarded CAS; a probe that THROWS is recorded as probe_failed rather than failing the job, so a row always exists per spec 3.7; no success-deletes-row branch); a provider-quota-probe-enqueue core maintenance task (5 min) owns scheduling so a broken chain self-heals; apps/worker/src/main.ts registers provider_quota_probe. 10 E2E (api_key + OAuth happy paths, not_supported/requires_separate_credential with a throwing fetch, 403 -> unauthorized + 1h backoff, malformed base URL -> probe_failed row, disabled -> canceled + no row, expired-token refresh write-back, lost CAS race, upsert, maintenance enqueue dedupe) and 20 unit tests passed. Collateral repair: adding a third core maintenance task broke worker-maintenance.e2e.case.ts (executedTasks pinned at 2 -> 3) and made worker-model-operations' description stale (three -> four durable jobs). pnpm run verify (371 unit + build, EXIT=0) and verify:features (16/16, zero regression) passed.

features.name: Provider Quota Console
features.description: The Providers page shows each connection's stored upstream quota: window utilization as a percentage with its reset time, balance with its currency, an explicit reason when the Provider cannot report, and 'not yet queried' when no probe has run; the page never overflows at 1280 or 390.
features.verification: pnpm exec vitest run tests/features/provider-quota-console.unit.test.ts && pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/provider-quota-console.e2e.spec.ts --workers=1
features.evidence: 2026-07-20: TDD red-to-green for steps 2.1-2.2. New packages/db/src/console-provider-quota.ts (listConsoleProviderQuotaSummaries) copies console-provider-health's withPooledPostgresClient + three-kind provider_connections CTE and left-joins provider_quota_summary, so a connection with no row yields entries: [], errorCode: null, observedAt: null — 'not yet queried', distinct from an error_code meaning 'cannot be retrieved'; ordering is in SQL and the ./console-provider-quota subpath was added to packages/db/package.json. Rendering: apps/console/src/app/_lib/provider-quota-format.ts holds the pure view builder (discriminates on isWindowEntry/isBalanceEntry from @llmingress/domain/quota, never a type tag, so one connection can show windows AND a balance); providers-section.tsx loads the read model and providers-client-section.tsx renders a new Quota column plus a provider-level shared-balance line. requires_separate_credential and not_supported render as a neutral pill with a reason and no zero value; probe_failed and unauthorized get pill--warn; window entries show a percentage (<1% rather than 0% for a live-but-tiny window) plus a relative reset; observedAt shows 'Updated N min ago'. An identical currency+total across several connections of one Provider is lifted to one 'shared across N connections' line and removed from the per-connection rows, since balance is account-scoped. 16 unit tests and 2 E2E (read-model DB assertions; booted Console asserting all four states, the single shared pool, and no horizontal overflow at 1280 or 390) passed. pnpm run verify (387 unit + build, EXIT=0) and verify:features (17/17, zero regression) passed.
